fusions.name: Plate-Splitting Knuckle
fusions.desc: A steel-shod knuckle blow that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Breastplate Drumming
fusions.desc: You beat your plated chest, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Crossed-Arm Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage, up to 4 blows, and holds for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while you carry it.

fusions.name: Riveted Hide
fusions.desc: Conjures layered plate over your hide: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
